title: One theta cycle, two modes

phases.label: encode
phases.note: entorhinal input (the world) dominates CA1; LTP is strong; CA3's stored patterns are damped

phases.label: retrieve
phases.note: CA3 input (the stored pattern) dominates; plasticity is weak, so recall does not overwrite itself

note: After Hasselmo, Bodelon and Wyble (2002). The phases are the model's; the closed-loop test of them is Siegle and Wilson (2014).
